title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12471)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12471) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12471).

clause_2_normative_references.title: Connecting dimensions, fits and dimensions combinations of hands for clocks

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
